pages.text:
A world of dreams in Faizu’s mind,
Filled with sweets of every kind.
Peda, rasmalai and kheer so sweet,
Oh, what a delicious treat!
pages.change: We enter a dream world made of sweets inside Faizu's mind.
pages.page_turn_note: An open invitation into the dream.

notes: a pastry bird carries a fruit across a white page; flowers, sweets floating on a river of milk
illustration.only_in_image: The page shows no sleeping child: the dream starts before we learn he is asleep.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
First up, all hail the king of ghee:
King Mysore pak! Enter, please!
pages.change: A parade begins: the first sweet, the king, is called in.
pages.page_turn_note: The call to the king leads straight into his page.

notes: a parade of sweet-roll carts on jalebi wheels; Faizu and a blue cat blow horns made of sweets
illustration.only_in_image: A blue cat rides along, never named in the text.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
Mysore pak, Mysore pak!
Pointy-cornered Mysore pak!
If the king is here in his darbar
Can the queen herself be far?
pages.change: The king is praised and the queen is promised next.
pages.page_turn_note: Ends on a question the next page answers with the queen.

notes: a crowned throne built of Mysore pak; the blue cat lies on it peering through a telescope

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
Kaju katli, kaju katli!
Shimmering-glittering kaju katli.
Creamy white is this katli,
Dancing a jig with jalebi.
pages.change: The queen appears and is linked to the next sweet.
pages.page_turn_note: Last line names the next sweet.

notes: a crowned kaju katli queen among diamond-shaped sweets; Faizu holds up a flag; garlands of cashews hang above
illustration.only_in_image: The queen is a crowned sweet; Faizu holds a flag like a herald.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
Orange jalebi, orange jalebi!
Twisting, turning orange jalebi.
pages.change: The jalebi verse: things twist and turn.

notes: Faizu and the cat tangled in giant jalebi spirals
illustration.only_in_image: Faizu and the cat are caught up in the giant spirals.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
How many hands has jalebi got?
Like boondis in a laddoo—a lot!
pages.change: A riddle about the jalebi's hands; the answer points to the laddoo.
pages.page_turn_note: Riddle answered by a comparison that names the next sweet.

notes: Faizu counts, puzzled, kneeling on a heap of boondi; numbers and a question mark float in the air
illustration.only_in_image: Faizu is shown counting with numbers and a question mark in the air.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
Boondi laddoo, boondi laddoo!
Turning, tumbling, playful laddoo.
pages.change: The laddoo verse: Faizu tumbles over laddoos.
pages.page_turn_note: Reader reloaded after this page; boundary to p8 slightly uncertain.

notes: three views of Faizu tumbling over a field of giant laddoos
illustration.only_in_image: Three Faizus in one picture show the tumbling as motion.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
Laddoo, is anyone as round as you?
The golden gulab jamun, that’s who!
pages.change: A question to the laddoo is answered with the next sweet.

notes: Faizu rolls across a giant laddoo; the cat lies on top of a gulab jamun in a bowl of syrup

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
Gulab jamun, gulab jamun!
Bobbing in syrup, gulab jamun!
Who else swims like you?
We call him the rasgulla, we do!
pages.change: Floating in syrup; another question passes to the next sweet.

notes: Faizu floats on his back, eyes closed, in a pool of syrup among gulab jamuns; the cat curled on one; a giant spoon dips in
illustration.only_in_image: Faizu floats with his eyes closed: the picture already hints at sleep.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
Dear rasgulla, sweet rasgulla!
Soft and juicy rasgulla.
Rolling about here, there and everywhere
Halwa asks, “Are you going somewhere?”
pages.change: Rasgullas roll everywhere; halwa asks where they are going.
pages.page_turn_note: A sweet itself asks the question.

notes: the cat plays on its back in a heap of rasgullas
illustration.only_in_image: Only the cat is shown, playing on its back.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
Carrot halwa, carrot halwa!
Steaming hot carrot halwa.
A bite warms Faizu’s heart.
pages.change: The last sweet, warm halwa, warms Faizu's heart; the verse is left without its rhyme.
pages.page_turn_note: The rhyme of this couplet arrives only on the next page.

notes: close-up of Faizu hugging a big bowl of carrot halwa, mouth open in wonder
illustration.only_in_image: A big close-up of his face: the most intimate picture so far.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text: Oh no! He wakes up with a start.
pages.change: He wakes suddenly: the dream world is gone and we see a real child in bed.
pages.page_turn_note: Strongest turn: from daylight dream to dark night; the rhyme completes across the page turn.

notes: night on a rooftop; Faizu lies on a rope cot under a green blanket with the grey cat curled beside him; crescent moon; his sandals on the floor. Only the picture shows he is a sleeping child on a rooftop and that the blue cat of the dream is his real grey cat.
illustration.only_in_image: Only the picture shows he sleeps on a rope cot on a rooftop under the moon, and that the dream cat is his real cat.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
Where did you go, laddoo, jamun and katli?
Halwa, Mysore pak and barfi?
Faizu has his eyes tightly closed,
pages.change: He calls the sweets back and shuts his eyes tight to return to sleep.
pages.page_turn_note: The sentence breaks off with a comma and finishes on the last page.

notes: Faizu wrapped in the blanket, smiling with eyes shut, the cat at his chin; all the sweets of the dream float around him in the dark
illustration.only_in_image: He is smiling under the blanket with all the sweets floating around him in the dark.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text: Off to dance with the sweets he goes.
pages.change: He goes back into the dream to dance with the sweets.

notes: daylight dream again; Faizu dances past a tree hung with barfi; the blue cat by a pond; jalebi sun over halwa hills
illustration.only_in_image: The dream world returns in daylight colours; the cat is blue again.
